classification: Accepted maximum starting port cannot advance dispatcher allocation coherently
relationship: An allocated listening port and the next allocation state must remain coherent across the full accepted starting-port range. Reserving a port must represent exhaustion rather than overflowing the retained counter before the current launch.
source_counterexample: CLI base_port is an unconstrained u16, so --base-port 65535 is admitted. On the first inserted request, callback copies65535 to local port then executes *p +=1 in u16 before launch_arguments/materialization/authorization. Overflow-checked execution panics here and never launches the current valid65535 allocation; unchecked arithmetic stores0 as the next allocation. No need to create many missions or invoke external services to derive the boundary.
actual_path: Ordinary admitted CLI and actual on_insert callback, not a fabricated private struct or only arbitrary API combination. No process/network execution or observed deployed outage claimed. Build-profile overflow mode not established; both possible arithmetic modes lack explicit exhaustion handling.
